MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CAST(CASE
    WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/') THEN STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
  END AS DATE) AS birth_date_value
WITH p,
  DATE_PART('year', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) - DATE_PART('year', birth_date_value) - CASE
    WHEN DATE_PART('month', birth_date_value) > DATE_PART('month', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE))
      OR (DATE_PART('month', birth_date_value) = DATE_PART('month', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE))
        AND DATE_PART('day', birth_date_value) > DATE_PART('day', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)))
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE (p.nationality = 'Slovenian' AND p.birth_date <> '1994/6/6')
   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND age > 78)
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
